title: 第23章 考验演技的时刻
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
大家的反应出奇的一致，狂喜之后撸起袖子问在哪呀？

    魏建业先打了个预防针，语气沉沉地说：“不一定是地下水，更不一定是饮用水。”

    谁都嚷嚷着先挖了再说。

    魏建业想了想，“妈，要不你再领我们去一趟吧。”

    蔡老太掸掸裤腿上的灰：“走呗”

    三个孩子溜溜哒地要跟上，赵玉兰一把薅回来直喊祖宗，“喊的不是你们，跟你们没关系。”

    她一看铁蛋的血盆大口，太阳穴的筋就突突突的跳动。

    哨所里的人把三孩子当眼珠子似的宠，立刻游说赵玉兰松口。

    今儿哨所带了个大箩筐装落叶，有人突发奇想地把三孩子玩里头一放，拍着心窝子跟赵玉兰保证绝不叫孩子累着，当真就这么抬着走。

    全家都走了，赵玉兰自然也得跟上，快走几步追上婆婆。

    哨所里平日巡逻外加做气象工作，一天来回二十多公里妥妥的。

    小老太腿脚也还利索，倒也没拖后腿。

    那竹编大箩筐到底承载不了三孩子的重量，半路整个底就掉了。

    苗苗和铁蛋屁股着地，芽芽圆润甚至还滚了一圈。

    糙汉们赶紧去搂，还心虚的扭头看蔡老太和赵玉兰的脸色。

    婆媳俩只能假装没看见。

    一行人紧赶慢赶的到大榕树下，蔡老太掷地有声的指着一处平坦的地面，“就是这。”

    说实在话，其他人光是肉眼也确实看不出啥特别之处。

    魏建业沉声说：“赌一把，挖挖看吧。”

    哨所的人就商量着怎么分配人手，有经验的就叨叨以前看人家挖过，三个壮劳力正常上下班，挖个七八米大概用两天。

    这纯纯手工活，差不多就是这数了。

    “所长，但咱人手可不多啊，今儿还得出海巡逻，还得分配人手驻守气象站。”

    “是啊，台风天后可忙。”

    魏建业沉吟着，“那就每天分配两个人手挖井，能挖多少是多少，先挖挖看。”
content_en:
Everyone's reaction was surprisingly unanimous. After being ecstatic, they rolled up their sleeves and asked where they were?

Wei Jianye took a shot first and said in a deep tone: "It's not necessarily groundwater, let alone drinking water."

Everyone clamored to dig first before talking.

Wei Jianye thought for a while, "Mom, why don't you take us there again."

Mrs. Cai dusted off the dust on her trouser legs and said, "Let's go."

The three children were scurrying to follow, but Zhao Yulan pulled them back and called her ancestors, "I'm not calling you, it has nothing to do with you."

As soon as she looked at Tiedan's bloody mouth, the tendons in her temples began to throb.

The people at the outpost doted on the three children as if they were eyesores, and immediately persuaded Zhao Yulan to relent.

Today, the outpost brought a large basket to hold fallen leaves. Someone suddenly put the three children in it to play with. He patted his heart and promised Zhao Yulan that he would never tire the children, and he really carried them away like this.

The whole family had left, so naturally Zhao Yulan had to follow her and walked a few steps quickly to catch up with her mother-in-law.

The outpost usually patrols and does meteorological work, and the round trip is more than 20 kilometers a day.

The little old lady's legs and feet were still nimble, but she didn't hold her back.

The large woven bamboo basket couldn't bear the weight of the three children, and the entire bottom fell off halfway.

Miaomiao and Tiedan landed on their butts, Yaya was round and even rolled around.

The rough guys hurriedly hugged her, and turned around to look at the faces of Mrs. Cai and Zhao Yulan with a guilty conscience.

The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law could only pretend not to see it.

The group of people hurriedly and slowly arrived under the big banyan tree. Mrs. Cai pointed to a flat ground loudly, "This is it."

To be honest, other people really can't see anything special with their naked eyes.

Wei Jianye said in a deep voice: "Take a gamble and dig into it."

The people at the outpost discussed how to allocate manpower. Those with experience said that they had seen digging before. It took about two days for three strong laborers to go to and from get off work normally.

This is pretty much all the pure manual work.

"Director, we don't have many manpower. We have to patrol the sea today, and we have to allocate manpower to garrison the weather station."

"Yes, Typhoon Queen is very busy."

Wei Jianye pondered, "Then allocate two people to dig wells every day. Let's dig as much as we can first."
title_en: Chapter 23 The moment to test your acting skills
